jobs.title: POS Systems Technician
jobs.short_description: Install and maintain point-of-sale systems across our restaurants.
jobs.full_description: You will install, configure and troubleshoot POS terminals, printers and payment devices in our 6 restaurants. You will also train staff on new features.

jobs.title: Junior Web Developer
jobs.short_description: Help build our online ordering platform.
jobs.full_description: Join a small team building a click-and-collect platform used by 40 restaurants. You will work on the React front end and help test new features.

jobs.title: IT Support Assistant
jobs.short_description: Be the first point of contact for IT issues in our kitchens and dining rooms.
jobs.full_description: You will handle Wi-Fi problems, tablets, kitchen display screens and reservation software. Evening availability is a plus.
